paper.title: Pareto Frontier of Neural Quantum States: Scalable, Affordable, and Accurate Convolutional Backflow for Strongly Correlated Lattice Fermions
paper.authors: Yuntian Gu, Zeyao Han, Wenrui Li, Zhiyu Xiao, Tao Xiang, Mingpu Qin, Liwei Wang, Dingshun Lv

results.system_description: 16x16 square lattice, periodic in both directions; U/t = 8, t'/t = -0.2; 224 electrons (112 up, 112 down), 1/8 hole doping
results.source_location: Table I, p. 8 (row ACE, column t' = -0.2, PBC)
results.eligibility_evidence: Variational energy of the ACE state on the 16 × 16 PBC cluster at U = 8, 1/8 hole doping, t' = -0.2; the ACE+GFMC row is a projected estimate and excluded.
results.notes: Table I caption: 'For results where statistical errors are not shown, they are one or several orders of magnitude smaller than the last displayed significant digit.' Recorded as an upper bound of one unit in the last printed digit. The table states that omitted statistical errors are smaller than the last displayed digit. Transcribed from the cited location of the versioned arXiv source and checked against the printed token; curator review pending. Parenthesized uncertainties are recorded as reported, with their meaning left unspecified unless the paper states it.
